sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen3.8-9B Distill Locally on a Single GPU - mindstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Guide to running Empero's Qwen3.8-9B distilled model locally: required kernels, sampling settings, and 262K context setup on one GPU.

sources.title: Zhipu AI Launches New Domain Z.ai and Open-Sources 32B/9B GLM Model Series
